First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
All levels, per the calendar entries.
Check
Look at @prideridesvt the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pride Rides Vermont Group Rides group ride

Pride Rides Vermont Group Rides is a mountain bike, gravel and social group ride in Burlington, VT. Schedule: Posted date by date on the group’s public calendar, mostly on weekend days. 2026 rides so far: Jan 18, Feb 11, May 1, May 30, Aug 9, Aug 14, Aug 15 and 16, Sept 27. The next ride is not posted yet. The time and start are on each calendar entry, from Changes with each ride; see the calendar entry.

A Vermont nonprofit that holds group rides for LGBTQIA+ riders: mountain bike, gravel and road paths. The rides move around the state and are posted one at a time on a public calendar. The group’s site says it exists to create a space to ride without having to hide.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
